author: EngineerErik
quote:
This game does not even feel like GTA. It has stunning graphics, the city is beautifully modeled. The story is absolute dogwater, politics shoved on every corner of the game in one way or another. and on basic PS5 you do not even have consistent 30fps, which in big 2026 is unaccaptable - this is not a MOVIE, but a GAME. I am sorry, but this causes me headaches and eyestrain.

Also the game feels like there is nothing to do apart from boring.
